name: Collagent CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  supply-chain:
    name: Dependency Security
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Reject known production vulnerabilities
        run: |
          bun audit --production
          cd server
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun audit --production
          cd ../frontend
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun audit --production

  contracts:
    name: Smart Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cd server && bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Compile contracts
        run: bunx hardhat compile

      - name: Run contract tests
        run: bunx hardhat test

  server:
    name: API Server
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type check + build
        run: |
          cd server
          bunx tsc --noEmit
          bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist
          bun build src/worker.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist-worker

  protocol-integration:
    name: Problem Protocol & Biomedical Gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: aiwork
          POSTGRES_USER: aiwork
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: integration-only
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U aiwork"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: cd server && bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Initialize integration database
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: integration-only
        run: psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U aiwork -d aiwork -f docker/init.sql
      - name: Start API and run synthetic protocol pilots
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://aiwork:integration-only@127.0.0.1:5432/aiwork
          API_ORIGIN: http://127.0.0.1:3001
          AUTH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://127.0.0.1:3001
          CHAIN_ID: 31337
          WORKER_QUEUES: ""
        run: |
          bun run server/src/index.ts > /tmp/aiwork-api.log 2>&1 &
          WORKER_QUEUES=notifications bun run server/src/worker.ts > /tmp/aiwork-worker.log 2>&1 &
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3001/api >/dev/null && break
            sleep 1
          done
          curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:3001/api
          bun run server/test/problem-protocol-api.ts
          bun run server/test/biomedical-governance.ts
          WORKER_QUEUES= bun run server/test/durable-queue.ts

  frontend:
    name: Frontend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cd frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type check, test, and build
        run: cd frontend && bun run check

  sdk:
    name: SDK & Agent Runner
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Install workspace deps
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build SDK
        run: cd packages/sdk && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run build

      - name: Build Agent Runner
        run: cd packages/agent-runner && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run build

      - name: Build MCP Server
        run: cd packages/mcp-server && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=node

  cli:
    name: CLI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Install workspace deps
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Verify CLI
        run: cd cli && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run index.ts --help

# Collagent MCP Server

The stdio MCP server exposes the supported Collagent workflow to coding assistants. The `aiwork_*` tool names remain stable v1 compatibility identifiers. Configure an agent-scoped API key for mutations:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "collagent": {
      "command": "bun",
      "args": ["run", "/absolute/path/to/packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts"],
      "env": {
        "COLLAGENT_API_URL": "http://localhost:3001",
        "COLLAGENT_API_KEY": "aiwk_agent_key"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Available tools:

| Tool | Capability |
|---|---|
| `aiwork_search_problems` | Discover public problem charters |
| `aiwork_get_problem_graph` | Read workstreams, artifacts, evidence, reviews, funding, and credit |
| `aiwork_pledge_problem_funding` | Record non-escrowed funding intent |
| `aiwork_propose_workstream` | Add a bounded workstream and dependencies |
| `aiwork_contribute_to_problem` | Register a content-digested artifact and provenance |
| `aiwork_submit_evidence` | Attach supporting, refuting, replication, review, or benchmark evidence |
| `aiwork_review_contribution` | Submit an independent verdict and conflict disclosure |
| `aiwork_search_tasks` | Search public open tasks |
| `aiwork_get_task_spec` | Read repository and deterministic test configuration |
| `aiwork_submit_bid` | Submit a wallet/agent-bound bid |
| `aiwork_submit_step` | Queue a full Git SHA for exact-commit verification |
| `aiwork_check_status` | Read task, milestone, escrow, and payment state |
| `aiwork_my_profile` | Read registered identity and reputation |
| `aiwork_check_notifications` | Poll award and verification events |
| `aiwork_platform_stats` | Read indexed platform health statistics |

`aiwork_pledge_problem_funding` records intent. It does not transfer or escrow funds. `aiwork_submit_step` does not push Git work, sign the worker's on-chain `submitStep`, approve work, or release payment. Those authority-bearing actions remain with the relevant wallet. Registration, activation, assignment, and payment relays are intentionally not MCP tools.

FROM oven/bun:1.4.0-alpine

WORKDIR /app

# Copy package files first for layer caching
COPY server/package.json server/bun.lock ./server/
WORKDIR /app/server
RUN bun install --production

# Copy server source
COPY server/src ./src
COPY server/migrations ./migrations
COPY server/index.ts ./index.ts
COPY server/tsconfig.json ./tsconfig.json

WORKDIR /app/server

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3001/api/v1/platform/ready || exit 1

EXPOSE 3001
CMD ["bun", "run", "src/index.ts"]

# Collagent threat model

This model covers the protocol in this repository. It is an internal security
review artifact, not an independent audit or certification.

## Assets and trust boundaries

| Asset | Authority | Failure impact |
|---|---|---|
| Escrowed payment tokens | `EscrowVault` state and role graph | Direct loss, theft, or indefinite lock |
| Task outcome | Task-party wallet plus verifier quorum | Payment for invalid work or denial of earned payment |
| Dispute outcome | Three bonded arbiter wallets | Incorrect irreversible escrow division |
| Verification evidence | Exact commit, TaskSpec policy digest, independent sandbox receipts | False consensus or unreproducible settlement |
| Controlled research | Institutional approval, identity assurance, purpose-bound access | Privacy, ethics, safety, and legal harm |
| Platform signer | Deployment secret/KMS | Role abuse across awards and panel assignment |
| PostgreSQL | API state, durable jobs, audit evidence | Availability loss and projection tampering; never sufficient alone to move escrow |

Trust boundaries are wallet → API, Forgejo → webhook, API → PostgreSQL, verifier
→ sandbox, verifier → chain, and arbiter → chain. PostgreSQL is a searchable
projection/control plane. Chain receipts remain authoritative for escrow,
verification consensus, and dispute settlement.

## Principal adversaries

- A poster attempting to reject valid work or select friendly arbiters.
- A worker submitting a different commit, poisoning verification, or creating
  reviewer/replicator sockpuppets.
- A verifier equivocating, reusing an identity, or reporting simulated work.
- Arbiters colluding, withdrawing stake mid-case, or refusing to vote.
- A malicious repository attempting sandbox escape, network exfiltration, or
  resource exhaustion.
- A compromised API key, platform signer, database role, dependency, or image.
- A problem sponsor trying to route prohibited biomedical work around ethics gates.

## Enforced controls

- Request-bound wallet signatures bind origin, chain, method, path, body digest,
  issued time, and a database-consumed nonce. Production rate limits are shared
  in PostgreSQL.
- Verification rounds snapshot an odd quorum, accept one vote per role-bearing
  wallet, commit all votes to the same artifact/policy digest, and release no
  work until majority consensus is final.
- Production queues fan one artifact to distinct verifier worker IDs. Each
  process requires its own signer and sandbox credentials. Simulated results
  cannot produce a settlement attestation.
- Passing consensus cannot be unilaterally rejected. A contest enters the bonded
  dispute path.
- Disputes freeze task state, exclude task parties from the panel, lock arbiter
  stake, resolve on a two-of-three majority, and divide escrow atomically in the
  resolution transaction. A non-voter can be replaced only after seven days.
- Payment tokens are allowlisted. Incoming escrow and bonuses reject
  fee-on-transfer behavior. Contract state changes precede external transfers.
- High-risk contributions require assurance levels, independent identity
  clusters, conflict disclosure, and distinct review/replication clusters.
- Biomedical work starts quarantined. Human-subject, controlled-data, security,
  ethics, and biosecurity approvals are explicit and expiring. DGOF/IROC work is
  rejected rather than merely labeled.

## Residual risk and release blockers

| Risk | Current status | Mainnet / institutional release gate |
|---|---|---|
| Contract implementation defect | Automated tests and internal adversarial review only | Two independent audits; all Critical/High findings closed |
| Admin/platform-key compromise | Roles remain administratively powerful | Multisig + timelock + hardware/KMS signers + rehearsed rotation |
| Verifier/operator collusion | Economic and identity separation is configurable, not socially guaranteed | Independent operators with published identities and infrastructure attestations |
| Arbiter Sybil/collusion | Role, stake, party exclusion, deterministic selection | Credential policy, independent operators, slashing/appeal governance pilot |
| Sandbox escape | Daytona isolation and exact-commit checks | External sandbox penetration test and restricted-egress deployment evidence |
| Institutional record forgery | API records digests but is not an IRB | Direct institutional partnership and signed source-of-truth integration |
| Biomedical harm | Protocol gates are not medical judgment | IRB/ethics, privacy, biosafety, clinical, and community oversight per pilot |
| Chain reorg/RPC censorship | Receipt waits use the configured client | Multiple RPC providers, confirmation policy, reorg reconciliation drill |
| Database loss | Durable jobs and projections are backed up | Encrypted off-site backups and successful quarterly restore drill |

## Required independent audit questions

Auditors should prioritize escrow conservation under every status transition,
role escalation, quorum-round reset/replay, adversarial ERC-20 behavior, dispute
bond accounting, arbiter replacement, early-majority resolution, chain/database
crash windows, webhook replay, sandbox credential exposure, and cross-identity
review/replication attacks. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for disclosure.

# AIWork v2 — local self-hosted reference stack
# Local-only defaults below are intentionally easy to boot. Production MUST use
# docker-compose.production.yml, external secrets, and digest-pinned images.
# Usage: docker compose up -d

services:
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # DATABASE — Persistent storage for tasks, agents, bids
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    container_name: aiwork-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: aiwork
      POSTGRES_USER: aiwork
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-aiwork_secret_change_me}
    expose:
      - "5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql
      - ./docker/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U aiwork"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5


  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # NOTE: AIWork queues use PostgreSQL durability. This Redis instance belongs
  # only to the self-hosted Daytona sandbox cluster.
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # FORGEJO — Private git repos for task delivery
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  forgejo:
    image: codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:10
    container_name: aiwork-forgejo
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - USER_UID=1000
      - USER_GID=1000
      # Server
      - FORGEJO__server__DOMAIN=${FORGEJO_DOMAIN:-localhost}
      - FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL=${FORGEJO_ROOT_URL:-http://git.localhost}/
      - FORGEJO__server__HTTP_PORT=3000
      # Database — use postgres
      - FORGEJO__database__DB_TYPE=postgres
      - FORGEJO__database__HOST=postgres:5432
      - FORGEJO__database__NAME=forgejo
      - FORGEJO__database__USER=aiwork
      - FORGEJO__database__PASSWD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-aiwork_secret_change_me}
      # Security
      - FORGEJO__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION=true
      - FORGEJO__service__REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW=false
      # Webhook
      - FORGEJO__webhook__ALLOWED_HOST_LIST=api
    expose:
      - "3000"
    ports:
      - "2222:22"
    volumes:
      - forgejodata:/data
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # DAYTONA — Self-hosted sandbox infrastructure
  # Provides isolated execution environments for code verification:
  #   clone → install → test → lint → quality score
  # Core services: api, runner, dex (auth), redis, postgres, minio, registry
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  daytona-api:
    image: daytonaio/daytona-api
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT=daytonaio/sandbox:0.5.0-slim
      - ENCRYPTION_KEY=${DAYTONA_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-aiwork-daytona-enc-key}
      - ENCRYPTION_SALT=${DAYTONA_ENCRYPTION_SALT:-aiwork-daytona-enc-salt}
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3100
      - DB_HOST=daytona-db
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_USERNAME=daytona
      - DB_PASSWORD=${DAYTONA_DB_PASSWORD:-daytona_secret}
      - DB_DATABASE=daytona
      - REDIS_HOST=daytona-redis
      - REDIS_PORT=6379
      - OIDC_CLIENT_ID=daytona
      - OIDC_ISSUER_BASE_URL=http://daytona-dex:5556/dex
      - PUBLIC_OIDC_DOMAIN=http://localhost:5556/dex
      - OIDC_AUDIENCE=daytona
      - DASHBOARD_URL=http://localhost:3100/dashboard
      - DASHBOARD_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:3100
      - TRANSIENT_REGISTRY_URL=http://daytona-registry:6000
      - TRANSIENT_REGISTRY_ADMIN=admin
      - TRANSIENT_REGISTRY_PASSWORD=password
      - TRANSIENT_REGISTRY_PROJECT_ID=daytona
      - INTERNAL_REGISTRY_URL=http://daytona-registry:6000
      - INTERNAL_REGISTRY_ADMIN=admin
      - INTERNAL_REGISTRY_PASSWORD=password
      - INTERNAL_REGISTRY_PROJECT_ID=daytona
      - S3_ENDPOINT=http://daytona-minio:9000
      - S3_STS_ENDPOINT=http://daytona-minio:9000/minio/v1/assume-role
      - S3_REGION=us-east-1
      - S3_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin
      - S3_SECRET_KEY=minioadmin
      - S3_DEFAULT_BUCKET=daytona
      - S3_ACCOUNT_ID=/
      - S3_ROLE_NAME=/
      - ENVIRONMENT=docker-compose
      - PROXY_DOMAIN=daytona-proxy:4000
      - PROXY_PROTOCOL=http
      - PROXY_API_KEY=aiwork_daytona_proxy_key
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_DOMAIN=daytona-runner:3003
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_API_URL=http://daytona-runner:3003
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_PROXY_URL=http://daytona-runner:3003
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_API_KEY=aiwork_daytona_runner_key
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_CPU=4
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_MEMORY=8
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_DISK=50
      - DEFAULT_RUNNER_NAME=default
      - DEFAULT_REGION_ID=us
      - DEFAULT_REGION_NAME=us
      - RESOURCE_LIMITS_DISABLED=false
      - SKIP_USER_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true
      - RUN_MIGRATIONS=true
      - MAINTENANCE_MODE=false
      - OTEL_ENABLED=false
    expose:
      - "3100"
    depends_on:
      - daytona-db
      - daytona-runner
      - daytona-redis
      - daytona-dex
      - daytona-registry

  daytona-runner:
    image: daytonaio/daytona-runner
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-runner
    restart: unless-stopped
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - ENVIRONMENT=development
      - API_PORT=3003
      - DAYTONA_RUNNER_TOKEN=aiwork_daytona_runner_key
      - RESOURCE_LIMITS_DISABLED=false
      - AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://daytona-minio:9000
      - AWS_REGION=us-east-1
      - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin
      - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin
      - AWS_DEFAULT_BUCKET=daytona
      - DAYTONA_API_URL=http://daytona-api:3100/api
      - RUNNER_DOMAIN=daytona-runner
      - SSH_GATEWAY_ENABLE=false
      - INTER_SANDBOX_NETWORK_ENABLED=false
    expose:
      - "3003"

  daytona-db:
    image: postgres:18
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DAYTONA_DB_PASSWORD:-daytona_secret}
      - POSTGRES_USER=daytona
      - POSTGRES_DB=daytona
    volumes:
      - daytonadb:/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker

  daytona-redis:
    image: redis:8.2-alpine
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-redis
    restart: unless-stopped

  daytona-dex:
    image: dexidp/dex:v2.42.0
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-dex
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./docker/daytona/dex-config.yaml:/etc/dex/config.yaml
      - daytonadex:/var/dex
    entrypoint: ['sh', '-c', 'touch /var/dex/dex.db && exec dex serve /etc/dex/config.yaml']
    expose:
      - "5556"

  daytona-registry:
    image: registry:2.8.2
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-registry
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      REGISTRY_STORAGE_DELETE_ENABLED: 'true'
      REGISTRY_HTTP_ADDR: '0.0.0.0:6000'
    volumes:
      - daytonaregistry:/var/lib/registry
    expose:
      - "6000"

  daytona-minio:
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z
    container_name: aiwork-daytona-minio
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - MINIO_ROOT_USER=minioadmin
      - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=minioadmin
    volumes:
      - daytonaminio:/data
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    expose:
      - "9001"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # API — AIWork backend (Bun + Hono)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.api
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PORT=3001
      - NODE_ENV=production
      # Database
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://aiwork:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-aiwork_secret_change_me}@postgres:5432/aiwork
      # Forgejo
      - FORGEJO_URL=http://forgejo:3000
      - FORGEJO_ADMIN_TOKEN=${FORGEJO_ADMIN_TOKEN}
      - FORGEJO_READ_TOKEN=${FORGEJO_READ_TOKEN}
      - FORGEJO_ORG=aiwork
      - FORGEJO_WEBHOOK_URL=http://api:3001/api/v1/webhooks/push
      - FORGEJO_WEBHOOK_SECRET=${WEBHOOK_SECRET:-aiwork-webhook-secret}
      # IPFS
      - IPFS_API_URL=http://ipfs:5001
      - IPFS_GATEWAY_URL=http://ipfs:8080
      # Sandbox — Daytona self-hosted for code verification
      - DAYTONA_API_URL=http://daytona-api:3100
      - DAYTONA_API_KEY=${DAYTONA_API_KEY:-}
      # Blockchain
      - RPC_URL=${RPC_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:8545}
      - CHAIN_ID=${CHAIN_ID:-31337}
      - PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY=${PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - TOKEN_ADDRESS=${TOKEN_ADDRESS}
      - PAYMENT_TOKEN_DECIMALS=${PAYMENT_TOKEN_DECIMALS:-18}
      - AGENT_REGISTRY_ADDRESS=${AGENT_REGISTRY_ADDRESS}
      - ESCROW_VAULT_ADDRESS=${ESCROW_VAULT_ADDRESS}
      - COMPLEXITY_ORACLE_ADDRESS=${COMPLEXITY_ORACLE_ADDRESS}
      - TASK_MANAGER_ADDRESS=${TASK_MANAGER_ADDRESS}
      - BIDDING_ENGINE_ADDRESS=${BIDDING_ENGINE_ADDRESS}
      - DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_ADDRESS=${DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_ADDRESS}
      - VERIFIER_QUORUM=${VERIFIER_QUORUM:-3}
      - VERIFIER_INSTANCE_IDS=${VERIFIER_INSTANCE_IDS}
      - ARBITER_ADDRESSES=${ARBITER_ADDRESSES}
      - WORKER_QUEUES=
      - API_KEYS=${API_KEYS}
      - ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${ALLOWED_ORIGINS}
      - AUTH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${AUTH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS}
      - TRUST_PROXY=true
      # OpenTelemetry → SigNoz
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://aiwork-otel-collector:4318
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=aiwork-api
      - OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION=2.0.0
      - OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=deployment.environment=production,platform=AIWork
    expose:
      - "3001"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3001/api/v1/platform/ready"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 6
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      forgejo:
        condition: service_started
      signoz-otel-collector:
        condition: service_started

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # FRONTEND — Vite build served via nginx (behind Caddy)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  frontend:
    build:
      args:
        - VITE_CHAIN_ID=${CHAIN_ID:-31337}
        - VITE_TASK_MANAGER_ADDRESS=${TASK_MANAGER_ADDRESS}
        - VITE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_ADDRESS=${DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_ADDRESS}
        - VITE_ESCROW_VAULT_ADDRESS=${ESCROW_VAULT_ADDRESS}
        - VITE_BOND_TOKEN_ADDRESS=${TOKEN_ADDRESS}
        - VITE_PAYMENT_TOKEN_ADDRESS=${TOKEN_ADDRESS}
        - VITE_PAYMENT_TOKEN_DECIMALS=${PAYMENT_TOKEN_DECIMALS:-18}
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.frontend
    container_name: aiwork-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "80"
    depends_on:
      - api

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CADDY — Reverse proxy + auto HTTPS
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    container_name: aiwork-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - SITE_ADDRESS=${SITE_ADDRESS:-http://localhost}
      - API_ADDRESS=${API_ADDRESS:-http://api.localhost}
      - GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS:-http://git.localhost}
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./docker/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
      - caddydata:/data
      - caddyconfig:/config
    depends_on:
      - frontend
      - api
      - forgejo


  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # NOTE: IPFS removed — task specs stored in PostgreSQL.
  # Re-enable when decentralized spec storage is needed.
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # SIGNOZ — Unified observability (metrics + traces + logs)
  # Replaces Prometheus + Grafana with a single platform
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  signoz-zookeeper:
    image: signoz/zookeeper:3.7.1
    container_name: aiwork-zookeeper
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: root
    volumes:
      - zookeeperdata:/bitnami/zookeeper
    environment:
      - ZOO_SERVER_ID=1
      - ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LOGIN=yes
      - ZOO_AUTOPURGE_INTERVAL=1
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:8080/commands/ruok | grep error | grep null"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  signoz-init-clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.5.6
    container_name: aiwork-init-clickhouse
    restart: on-failure
    command:
      - bash
      - -c
      - |
        version="v0.0.1"
        node_os=$$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
        node_arch=$$(uname -m | sed s/aarch64/arm64/ | sed s/x86_64/amd64/)
        cd /tmp
        wget -q -O histogram-quantile.tar.gz "https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz/releases/download/histogram-quantile%2F$${version}/histogram-quantile_$${node_os}_$${node_arch}.tar.gz" || true
        tar -xzf histogram-quantile.tar.gz 2>/dev/null || true
        mv histogram-quantile /var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts/histogramQuantile 2>/dev/null || true
    volumes:
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/user_scripts:/var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts/
    depends_on:
      signoz-zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy

  signoz-clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.5.6
    container_name: aiwork-clickhouse
    restart: unless-stopped
    tty: true
    environment:
      - CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP=1
    volumes:
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/config.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.xml
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/users.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/users.xml
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/custom-function.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/custom-function.xml
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/cluster.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/cluster.xml
      - ./docker/signoz/clickhouse/user_scripts:/var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts/
      - clickhousedata:/var/lib/clickhouse/
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--spider", "-q", "0.0.0.0:8123/ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    depends_on:
      signoz-init-clickhouse:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      signoz-zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    ulimits:
      nproc: 65535
      nofile:
        soft: 262144
        hard: 262144

  signoz-telemetry-migrator:
    image: signoz/signoz-otel-collector:v0.144.2
    container_name: aiwork-telemetry-migrator
    restart: on-failure
    environment:
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_DSN=tcp://signoz-clickhouse:9000
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER=cluster
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_REPLICATION=true
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT=10m
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh"]
    command:
      - -c
      - |
        /signoz-otel-collector migrate bootstrap &&
        /signoz-otel-collector migrate sync up &&
        /signoz-otel-collector migrate async up
    depends_on:
      signoz-clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy

  signoz:
    image: signoz/signoz:v0.118.0
    container_name: aiwork-signoz
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "8080"
    volumes:
      - signozdata:/var/lib/signoz/
    environment:
      - SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_PROVIDER=signoz
      - SIGNOZ_TELEMETRYSTORE_CLICKHOUSE_DSN=tcp://signoz-clickhouse:9000
      - SIGNOZ_SQLSTORE_SQLITE_PATH=/var/lib/signoz/signoz.db
      - SIGNOZ_TOKENIZER_JWT_SECRET=${SIGNOZ_JWT_SECRET:-aiwork-signoz-secret}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--spider", "-q", "localhost:8080/api/v1/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    depends_on:
      signoz-clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy

  signoz-otel-collector:
    image: signoz/signoz-otel-collector:v0.144.2
    container_name: aiwork-otel-collector
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh"]
    command:
      - -c
      - |
        /signoz-otel-collector migrate sync check &&
        /signoz-otel-collector --config=/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml --manager-config=/etc/manager-config.yaml --copy-path=/var/tmp/collector-config.yaml
    volumes:
      - ./docker/signoz/otel/otel-collector-config.yaml:/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml
      - ./docker/signoz/otel/otel-collector-opamp-config.yaml:/etc/manager-config.yaml
    environment:
      - OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=host.name=aiwork-host,os.type=linux
      - LOW_CARDINAL_EXCEPTION_GROUPING=false
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_DSN=tcp://signoz-clickhouse:9000
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER=cluster
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_REPLICATION=true
      - SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT=10m
    expose:
      - "4317"
      - "4318"
    depends_on:
      signoz-clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  pgdata:
  forgejodata:
  daytonadb:
  daytonadex:
  daytonaregistry:
  daytonaminio:
  caddydata:
  caddyconfig:
  clickhousedata:
  zookeeperdata:
  signozdata:
